_help: The Canteen page (canteen.html) and the Home page note are drawn from this file. Each week, replace the "week" block with the new flyer's details. "from" and "to" are the first and last day it covers (YYYY-MM-DD). After the "to" date passes, the site stops showing the week's games and specials by itself and falls back to the "standing" block, so nothing stale stays up. Leave "hours" empty if they are not set. Prices are plain text.
